For taxable years starting January 1, 2006 or later, eligible individuals may claim a credit equal to **"20 percent of the credit claimed by the individual or married individuals for federal individual income taxes pursuant to § 32 of the Internal Revenue Code"** (nonrefundable).

**2022-2024:** The statute permits **"a refundable credit...in an amount equal to 15 percent of the credit claimed...for federal individual income taxes"** for those eligible under Section 32 of the Internal Revenue Code.

**2025-2026:** The refundable credit increases to **"20 percent of the credit claimed by the individual or married individuals for federal individual income taxes"** for the same eligible taxpayers.

## Key Limitation

These credits are mutually exclusive. The statute specifies: **"In no case shall a household be allowed a credit pursuant to this subdivision and subdivision 1 or 2 for the same taxable year."**

The refundable credits must be claimed on Virginia income tax returns and redeemed through the Tax Commissioner.
